note: Which Ollama models Joe suggests for each amount of graphics memory (GB). Joe reads the copy of this file on GitHub (main branch) about once a week, so suggestions can change without a new release. Only Ollama library names, sizes in GB. "writing": "role" recommended (Joe's pick), alternative (the other good choice) or free (little to no filtering); Joe's pick for each card size (name) plus "others": two more choices the person can pick instead, each with who made it and a plain note. At least one choice per size is lightly filtered or unfiltered ("role": "free"), so people can pick freedom over a company's filters. "styles": words in picture-model file names that suit each picture style, best first. "style_models": community picture models Joe recommends per style (the person downloads them from the page; Joe moves them into ComfyUI). "looks": sub-looks per picture style (match words, prompt words, example for the prompt writer, targeted leave-out words, trigger words for add-ons).
